sunforge-story.text: Stage each page as grounded human behavior inside a lived frontier community. Keep acting natural and conversational: Brandon is calm and practical rather than posed as a hunted fugitive, Eva is active and curious rather than a solemn detective, and Jessie remains task-focused even when amused or concerned. Background people continue working, watching, eating, arguing or helping instead of freezing around the principals. Strange events remain visually ordinary unless the panel plan explicitly calls for the Rider's spatial anomaly; never add visible probability, fate, prophecy or supernatural effects. Caption narration is dry and factual about ordinary things and does not explain the larger mystery.
